adminPage.title: Admin
adminPage.rightPanelDescription: Manage the instance from this screen. Every action is also verified for admin permission on the server.

relaysPanel.title: Fediverse relays
relaysPanel.description: Manage relay inbox URLs used to send and receive public posts.

serverBlocksPanel.deniedDescription: Posts from users on these servers (including subdomains) are only accepted if someone here follows them or has added them to a list. Replies, quotes, mentions, DMs and reactions toward users who don't follow them are also dropped, and their follow requests are rejected automatically (Bluesky follows are recorded but not notified). Their posts never appear on the global or hashtag timelines. Delivery from this server and interaction with accounts you follow continue as before. Applies to Fediverse servers and ATP PDSes.

authIpBlocksPanel.title: Blocked IPs
authIpBlocksPanel.description: IP addresses automatically blocked after triggering login/TOTP brute-force detection. You can lift a block individually.
authIpBlocksPanel.emptyMessage: No IP addresses are currently blocked.

emojisPanel.title: Custom emojis

importReasons.file_missing: Image file not found in the ZIP
importReasons.zip_missing: The server cannot find the ZIP (check that the work directory is shared)

emojisPanel.tagsLabel: Tags (optional, space or comma separated. Used for partial matches in the picker)

siteSettingsPanel.title: Site settings
siteSettingsPanel.siteNameHtmlHint: HTML tags are allowed (used for the site title on the login screen). Other places, such as federation notifications or the PWA name, use a plain-text version with tags stripped.
siteSettingsPanel.siteDescriptionHint: Shown on the login screen. HTML tags are allowed and line breaks are preserved as-is. This is an admin-only input, so it is not sanitized.
siteSettingsPanel.termsOfServiceHint: Shown as an agreement checkbox on the sign-up screens (including migrating from Bluesky) and on “About this site” (/about). HTML tags are allowed and line breaks are preserved as-is (white-space: pre-wrap). Leave empty to hide the checkbox entirely. This is an admin-only input, so it is not sanitized.
siteSettingsPanel.loginBackgroundHint: You can upload either an image or a video. Videos autoplay and loop (muted) on the login screen. If left unset, the background is derived from the site color.
siteSettingsPanel.storageNotConfigured: Cannot upload because no storage is configured. Add one in the storage settings
siteSettingsPanel.mediaProxyHint: Leave blank to use this server's /proxy endpoint. Enter the full Misskey-compatible endpoint URL, including the trailing /proxy path.
siteSettingsPanel.passwordSetPlaceholder: Set (enter a new value to change it)
siteSettingsPanel.smtpConnectionOk: Connected and authenticated to the SMTP server
siteSettingsPanel.smtpTestEmailSent: Test email sent. Check the inbox (or the spam folder if it does not arrive)
siteSettingsPanel.smtpTestHint: Tests use the values currently entered, before saving. If the password field is empty, the saved password is used.

smtpTestFailure.SMTP_FAILED: Communication with the SMTP server failed

siteSettingsPanel.requireVerifyHint: SMTP must be configured before requiring email verification.
siteSettingsPanel.bruteforceHint: Login is rejected once the number of distinct passwords tried for the same username (within this window, or since the user's last password reset if more recent) exceeds this number. The same value is also used for the reverse check (distinct usernames tried against the same password) and for TOTP code verification.
siteSettingsPanel.ipBlockHint: An IP address that triggers this many brute-force rejections within the window is blocked for the given duration. See the "Blocked IPs" tab to view or lift blocks.
siteSettingsPanel.passwordResetMaxActiveLabel: Max active password reset/verification emails per address
siteSettingsPanel.maxUserAccountsHint: New sign-ups and migrations are refused once the total number of accounts, including withdrawn, suspended and DID-migrated-out ones, reaches this value. 0 means unlimited.
siteSettingsPanel.registrationClosedHint: When checked, all new sign-ups, email verification and DID migrations are refused. Existing users are not affected.
siteSettingsPanel.turnstileHint: Turnstile is enabled on the sign-up pages (including the email verification request) once both keys are set.
siteSettingsPanel.turnstileTestSolve: Complete the widget check shown below.
siteSettingsPanel.turnstileTestHint: Tests the values currently entered, before saving. If the Secret Key field is empty, the saved value is used.

turnstileTestFailure.TURNSTILE_FAILED: Siteverify rejected the token (check that the Secret Key pairs with the Site Key)
turnstileTestFailure.WIDGET: The widget returned an error (check the Site Key and that this domain is allowed in Cloudflare)

siteSettingsPanel.cloudflareDnsHint: When both are set, an _atproto.{handle} TXT record is created automatically on sign-up and similar events. Otherwise only /.well-known/atproto-did is used. The token needs Zone > DNS > Edit permission on the target zone.
siteSettingsPanel.oembedAllowedDomainsHint: Specifying a domain that anyone can host content on (e.g. github.io, amazonaws.com) risks embedding malicious scripts on your site.
siteSettingsPanel.oembedEndpointHint: If a site supports oEmbed but doesn't advertise it via an HTML discovery tag, you can specify the endpoint directly using the format "domain,oembed-endpoint-url" (e.g. vimeo.com,https://vimeo.com/api/oembed.json).
siteSettingsPanel.aboutFieldsHint: All optional. Only the ones you set are shown on “About this site” (/about). The operator name and email address are also returned as the operator details in the Misskey- and Mastodon-compatible APIs. The operator URL must start with http:// or https://.
